image_description: A close-up shot of a white Apple iPod Classic inserted into a textured, off-white protective case or sleeve. The device features the characteristic rectangular shape with rounded corners, a screen displaying the Apple logo and menu text, and the circular click wheel interface below the screen. A portion of another similar device is visible in the background on the right.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible and nonsensical ('Joo...'), failing to render clear UI elements or readable fonts, which is a common AI artifact.
The texture of the white case appears slightly smudged and lacks consistent fabric or leather grain detail, looking somewhat 'painted' or soft-focused.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom edge of the iPod/Case interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary where the iPod meets the case at the bottom is slightly blurred and indistinct, with the white dock connector area appearing to merge oddly with the case material.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic vs Nano vs Touch) and verify class alignment.
To analyze the illegible text on the screen and determine if it constitutes a significant failure in rendering UI elements.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the device and the protective sleeve, especially at the bottom dock area.
To assess general sharpness, noise, and any subtle global artifacts missed by specific checks.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of on-screen text/UI
Boundary definition between the iPod and the protective case
Geometric accuracy of the click wheel and screen proportions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the screen; AI often fails to render coherent UI text. Also, inspect the edges of the device where it enters the case for any signs of melting or structural ambiguity. The 'boot logo' on the screen is a key indicator of whether the AI understands the device's state or just pasted a generic apple shape.
